definitions.label: Open
definitions.meaning: Triaged and ready to pick up
definitions.hint: Triaged and ready to pick up

definitions.label: Blocked
definitions.meaning: Waiting on a named blocker (ticket, person, external)
definitions.hint: Waiting on a named blocker: a ticket, a person or something external

definitions.label: In progress
definitions.meaning: Actively worked on: a live session, branch or PR
definitions.hint: Actively worked on: a live session, branch or PR

definitions.label: QA
definitions.meaning: Built; in review, a gate or CI, waiting to merge
definitions.hint: Built; in review, a gate or CI, waiting to merge

definitions.label: Done
definitions.meaning: Merged. For non-code work (concepts, research): the result exists and passed review
definitions.hint: Merged, or for non-code work: the result exists and passed review

definitions.label: Accepted
definitions.meaning: Confirmed by a person or customer, or automatically after the period
definitions.hint: Confirmed by a person or customer, or automatically 30 days after delivery

definitions.label: Cancelled
definitions.meaning: Won’t be done (duplicate, obsolete, superseded); a reason is required
definitions.hint: Won’t be done: duplicate, obsolete or superseded. Needs a reason

queued.label: Queued
queued.meaning: Open or Blocked plus a place in the work queue (AEON-522); Blocked waits on its named blocker. When ready, the next free agent picks it up, then it becomes In progress automatically.

recurring.label: Recurring
recurring.meaning: The loop badge on a ticket's type icon means recurring work created this ticket. Its tooltip gives the schedule and occurrence number. The Recurring pill opens the source recurrence for people allowed to manage it; retired recurrences keep their existing tickets and markers. This is a marker, not a status.
